items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 6 ACs implemented and tested; spec-reviewer independently confirmed no scope creep beyond M1/M2 (27 files, none extra).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: build_bundle raises BundleCollisionError/UnsafeOutputPathError on real conflicts rather than guessing or crashing uncaught; main() catches both. No DB/external-service calls to guard.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input reaches SQL/HTML (build-time tooling, no web surface); no hardcoded secrets introduced. Internal Plan Review flagged that build_bundle copies from the raw filesystem rather than a git-tracked snapshot (a latent secret-leak vector once a publish milestone exists) - disclosed as a known limitation in the spec, not a defect in what shipped (dist/ is gitignored, local-only today).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests assert on outcomes (raised exceptions, manifest contents, hook order) not internal state; happy-path and error-path (collision, safety-guard) tests exist for every new code path.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: In-memory dict/list operations over 14 plugins, no N+1 pattern, no unbounded loops or blocking calls introduced.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: File locations match shared/scripts/tools/ convention. No file exceeds 300 lines (codex_hook_merge.py=136, codex_hook_inventory.py=181, build_codex_plugin.py=277, codex_bundle_safety.py=69) - split into two modules mid-iterate specifically to hold this line.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer/consumer pairs listed in the spec's Affected Boundaries table. Real round-trip probe exists and passes: verify_codex_plugin_bundle.py diffs the bundle against a fresh rebuild from the same sources (AC5, 4 tests).

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings.
